summary: The remaining mismatch is the skipped eat.c:cprefx() call on the tin-consumption route. The current evaluation matches 50/51 screens, 2624/2632 RNG calls, and all 51 cursor positions; at step 50 after the player accepts the tin, C displays “You cannibal! You will regret this!” and logs rn2(4)=1 from maybe_cannibal(), while JS leaves that message cell blank and proceeds to rn2(5)=4. C consume_tin() calls cprefx() before cpostfx(); JS still records note_unported("eat.c cprefx") at that call site, although its cprefx() helper and maybe_cannibal() implementation are used by ordinary corpse meals. The actionable scope remains a whole-function port of eat.c:cprefx() and wiring the existing tin caller while preserving the ordinary corpse caller. The earlier newuhs() stop was a real downstream symptom of missing Szechuan nutrition in the older implementation, but TIN_VARIETIES[9] now matches C (nutrition 70, greasy false), and the current replay no longer stops at the NaN/newuhs refusal. Separate downstream gaps remain in cpostfx(): JS still records note_unported("were.c set_ulycn") and note_unported("artifact.c retouch_equipment") for the human-wererat path.

source.branch: The Wizard uses #eat on a blessed homemade tin of human wererat meat, completes the opening delay, and answers yes to “Eat it?”. The C variety roll rn2(15)=9 selects tintxts[9], szechuan. consume_tin() calls cprefx(PM_HUMAN_WERERAT) before cpostfx(); cprefx() reaches maybe_cannibal(pm, TRUE), which emits the own-species warning, aggravates monsters, and consumes rn2(4). At current HEAD, the JS tin caller skips cprefx(), and the single remaining screen plus first RNG mismatch occurs at this step-50 branch.
callers: C eat.c:consume_tin() (1610-1615) calls cprefx(mnum), then cpostfx(mnum) if the tin remains. JS eat.js:consume_tin() (1158-1163) still places note_unported("eat.c cprefx") at the corresponding site.

The production command route is cmd.c #eat -> eat.c:doeat() tin arm (2953-2959) -> start_tin()/opentin() -> consume_tin(); JS cmd.js:runEatCommand() (3225 onward) -> eat.js:doeat() -> start_tin() (4069, 4207) -> opentin() (1243) -> consume_tin() (1076).

C also calls cprefx() from eat.c:start_eating() for corpse meals (2040-2045); JS eat.js:start_eating() (3356-3362) already wires its cprefx helper on that path. Preserve this caller while wiring the tin route.
dependencies: C maybe_cannibal() (eat.c:758-788) returns a boolean that cprefx() discards; its visible message, aggravation state, luck change, and rn1(4, 2) draw remain required side effects. JS has maybe_cannibal() at eat.js:2153-2189, and cprefx() calls it at 2194-2195, but consume_tin() skips cprefx().

The whole eat.c:cprefx() source body (791-864) also depends on flesh_petrifies(), poly_when_stoned(), polymon(), revive_corpse(), and acidic() return values, and has stoning, Rider, green-slime and lizard branches. Current JS cprefx() at 2194-2244 retains UnsupportedEatError refusals for unsupported source branches, so the actionable unit is the whole function and required return-dependent callees, not only the observed cannibalism branch.

Historical counterevidence: the prior evaluation at 518d4526ccba82c89752a8babb892ba9bc48bc60, examined against implementation 45a483d2dd3320f9268aeb4477a785237e69df4e stopped at newuhs() because the then-current TIN_VARIETIES[9] omitted nutrition; that explanation was correct for that snapshot. Current JS eat.js:431-448 now includes Szechuan nutrition 70 and greasy false, matching C eat.c:tintxts[9], and the exact-HEAD evaluation reaches step 50. Do not retain missing tin metadata or NaN hunger as the current cause.

C cpostfx() maps PM_HUMAN_WERERAT to PM_WERERAT at eat.c:1144-1145 and later calls set_ulycn() and retouch_equipment(2) at 1323-1326. Current JS cpostfx() still records note_unported("were.c set_ulycn") and note_unported("artifact.c retouch_equipment") at eat.js:2746-2748; these genuine downstream gaps remain separate from the first cprefx mismatch.

evidence: The refreshed queue .cache/B79-final-work-queue.json and saved challenges/evaluations/20261001214251-v17.json agree on the current case identity and one remaining screen. Evaluation SHA 1f29dddb7791d0584379eeb425ef34791d600acc equals examined HEAD 1f29dddb7791d0584379eeb425ef34791d600acc; metrics are 50/51 screens, 2624/2632 RNG calls, and 51/51 cursors. Its first screen mismatch is segment 0 step 50 on key y at row 0, column 31 (C has Y; JS has a blank); its first RNG mismatch is index 2623 (C rn2(4)=1 at maybe_cannibal(eat.c:784), JS rn2(5)=4).

Immutable C recording challenges/cases/v17/tin-human-wererat-cpostfx-slot-n.session.json step 47 logs rn2(15)=9 at tin_variety(eat.c:1503), selecting Szechuan; step 50 on y shows “You consume szechuan wererat. You cannibal! You will regret this!” and begins with rn2(4)=1 @ maybe_cannibal(eat.c:784). The first 50 screens match in the current evaluation; the step-50 message and draw identify the omitted prefix call.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/eat.c:758-788 defines maybe_cannibal(); eat.c:791-864 defines cprefx(), whose first operation calls maybe_cannibal(pm, TRUE) at line 793. eat.c:1610-1615 calls cprefx() before cpostfx() in consume_tin(). In contrast, current js/eat.js:1158-1163 records note_unported("eat.c cprefx") before its cpostfx() call. The C and JS production command paths are traced in source.callers.

Current js/eat.js:431-448 defines Szechuan as {name: szechuan, nutrition: 70, healthFood: true, greasy: false}, matching upstream eat.c:tintxts[9] at lines 143-158. The previous evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261001190602-v17.json at commit 518d4526ccba82c89752a8babb892ba9bc48bc60 reported the downstream newuhs() stop when nutrition was absent; that historical finding is superseded by the restored fields and current step-50 mismatch.

Current JS eat.js:2194-2244 implements cprefx() only partially and includes UnsupportedEatError arms for source branches; eat.js:3356-3362 wires it for ordinary corpse meals. The missing tin caller is therefore the production gap even though the helper exists.

The lycanthropy/equipment follow-up remains: C eat.c:cpostfx() selects PM_WERERAT for PM_HUMAN_WERERAT at 1144-1145 and invokes set_ulycn()/retouch_equipment() at 1323-1326. Current JS eat.js:2746-2748 still calls note_unported("were.c set_ulycn") and note_unported("artifact.c retouch_equipment"); this report does not treat those gaps as resolved.
